newsitem.title: UK: Tradepoint says July was best month ever.
newsitem.headline: Tradepoint says July was best month ever.

text.p: Tradepoint Financial Networks Plc, the London Stock Exchange's fledgling rival, said on Thursday it had experienced its busiest ever month in July.

The exchange said it had traded 128.2 million stg worth of stock in the month, up from 40.6 million stg the previous month, with volume totalling 30.8 million shares. It said it had traded more than 1 billion stg since its launch in September 1995.
Tradepoint on Monday agreed a 11.4 million stg refinancing which will fund its activities for the foreseeable future. Its shares were up 10p at 90 by 1300 GMT.
